purpose: Measure response quality of a delivered inquiry instruction package on baseline-screened difficult, self-contained dilemmas. No installed-skill activation, hidden-reasoning, backend identity or general population uplift claim.

model.backend_identity: record host evidence separately; requested model is not proof of effective backend

inputs.writer_access: Both calibration and confirmation instances are writer-seen. Confirmation is a frozen new-instance set, not inaccessible/blind holdout.
inputs.freeze: After independent construct and oracle reviews, create a new pool-2 SHA256 freeze of exact cases, rubrics, protocol, root and reference bytes before pool-2 screening. Re-review work invalidated by repairs; two independent verification rounds are required before final delivery, not duplicate unchanged pretrial reviews. Preserve pool-1 frozen definitions and all outcomes. Never mutate frozen inputs after dispatch.

scoring.judging: Blind arm labels; judge only final answer against task-specific anchors. Alternative valid answers accepted; concise excellent answers receive full credit. No credit for length, framework names, lens count, novelty or private reasoning.
scoring.missing: Missing output is NOT_RUN/host failure, never a score of zero or task failure. Record every planned slot and outcome; scores require an actual output.

screening.exclude_if: At least 2 of 3 full passes OR normalized mean strictly greater than 0.70
screening.incomplete: Any family with a missing trial remains screening-incomplete and unselected; retain all outcomes without replacing the missing trial.
screening.zero_pass: Include 0/3 full-pass family only after independent reviewer validates at least one feasible oracle or decision-useful uncertainty answer and task clarity. Oracle authors are not independent validators.
screening.selection: Outcome-blind to treatment; preserve excluded families and reason. No scored treatment trials occur before family selection freezes; the neutral native delivery canary is exempt.
screening.insufficient_retention: If fewer than six pool-2 families qualify, report insufficient difficult-core coverage and preserve all results. Any further prospective replacement requires new evidence, a documented decision and new freeze, keeping one current candidate and never selecting for favorable treatment outcomes.
screening.no_later_filter: Do not filter confirmation based on either arm's results.

confirmation.families: All and only families selected from calibration; different supplied scenarios/numbers
confirmation.revision_rule: Any tuned or revised confirmation case becomes development and requires prospectively authored replacement and a new freeze; do not replace an unfavorable observed outcome.

controls.score_reporting: Separate conventional-winning checks outside difficult core; no core selection by control outcome.

counterfactual_links.K02: Simple serial-capacity control separate from capacity_adaptation/perishable_cutover
counterfactual_links.K03: Decisive existing-test control separate from perturbing_diagnosis

controls.comparability: Controls alter governing evidence/constraint toward a conventional winner; contrast reports are descriptive because instance content also changes.

budget.formula: 36 baseline screening + up to 72 confirmation + 6 controls
budget.canary: Out of score and outside planned model-output budget; record separately.
budget.candidate_scope: Maximum114 planned scored outputs for this prospective pool-2 only. Prior pool-1 outputs remain separate preserved records; no outcome reruns or retroactive replacement.

runtime.common_instructions: Same host context, task bytes, tools prohibition, final-answer budget and common system instructions across arms; record unmatched host context.

turn_order.method: Within each stage, use seeded shuffled family/instance blocks and alternate arm order across repetition blocks; retain fixed generated order before dispatch.
turn_order.screening: Only baseline arm; seeded shuffle of all calibration family/repetition slots.

treatment.delivery: Captured native delivery order: task, explicitly preloaded frozen inquiry-methods, evidence-and-diagnosis, alternatives-and-drafting references, then native root SKILL expansion named deep-inquiry:deep-inquiry. Verify exact bytes, uniqueness, source path and this order; host-provided context is outside the submitted input list.
treatment.record: Capture exact delivered text bytes/order and hashes. Method-only package; never include cases, rubrics, oracle answers or task-specific hints.
treatment.estimand: Effect of delivered root plus three-reference package, not root alone, natural activation or progressive-loading success.

runtime.baseline: No treatment root/references. Verify absence of accidental skill autoexpansion and prior task/answer context; unresolved contamination makes comparison ineligible.
runtime.canary: Before scored stages prove dispatch/result capture with an unscored neutral task; never use its answer as a scored output.

retries.allowed_only: Host trace positively proves model turn was never dispatched.
retries.ambiguous_dispatch: No retry; preserve unknown delivery as host failure/NOT_RUN.

reporting.preserve: All planned slots, actual outputs, scores, critical failures, missing/host failures, screened exclusions, selected families, model/effort evidence and eligibility limits.
reporting.primary: Per-family confirmation normalized score and full-pass rate by arm plus paired slot differences; aggregate only across selected difficult families with denominator shown.
reporting.controls: Report separately, including simple/conventional recommendation fidelity.
limitations: Baseline-conditioned selection restricts inference to selected difficult families.
Same family new-instance confirmation is not transfer to unseen reasoning families.
All suite instances and oracles are writer-seen; no inaccessible holdout claim.
Host labels alone do not establish effective model/effort or isolated instruction exposure.
reporting.no_result: This draft contains no actual target-model trial evidence.

provenance.reason: Completed prior screen selected zero families, providing evidence for this prospective replacement. Old simple calibration cases are outside active core.
provenance.baseline_assessment: Prior baseline already produced substantive correct reasoning; new candidate difficulty is empirically unverified.
provenance.treatment_package: Unchanged frozen method-only root and three references; no task-specific answer additions.
provenance.replacement_authority: Keep one current candidate. Further prospective replacement must be justified by new evidence, documented and newly frozen, preserving prior outcomes and excluding favorable treatment-based selection. The114-output limit is per prospective pool; no whole-goal token or output budget was set.
